The Moon is leaving us. 🌙

Every year, it drifts 3.8 centimeters farther from Earth.

Swipe to learn why this matters →

• In 600 million years, total solar eclipses will be impossible
• The Moon stabilizes Earth's tilt—without it, our seasons would be chaotic
• Tides would be 1/3 as strong
• Days would be shorter (the Moon slows Earth's rotation)

Appreciate that Moon while it's close. 💙

Today, Lesson of the Day PBC launches Curious Kelly: an AI-powered learning companion delivering 8-minute daily lessons for ages 2-102.

Our approach is different. Instead of personalization through learning style myths or interest-based algorithms, Kelly adapts ONE universal lesson to each learner's age and cognitive stage.

Same topic. Same day. Different complexity.

A 5-year-old and a 50-year-old both learn about the Sun—but through entirely different lenses.

We believe learning should be:
• Daily (habit > event)
• Universal (shared experience across ages)
• Adaptive (complexity, not topic, changes)
• Joyful (curiosity, not obligation)

365 lessons. 3 languages. Every age.

Learn more: curiouskelly.com

#EdTech #AI #Education #LifelongLearning #StartupLaunch

Why we built an AI teacher that teaches everyone the same thing.

In an era of hyper-personalization, we went the opposite direction.

Curious Kelly teaches ONE lesson per day. Same topic for a 5-year-old and a 75-year-old.

Why?

1. Shared experience creates connection. Families can discuss the same lesson at dinner.

2. Universal curiosity is real. Everyone wonders why the sky is blue.

3. Personalization often fails. 'Learning styles' are a myth. Complexity adaptation isn't.

4. Daily habit > weekly deep-dive. 8 minutes builds neural pathways that 2-hour sessions don't.

The magic isn't in the topic. It's in how Kelly explains it—adapting vocabulary, examples, and depth to each learner's age.

This is the future of education: not infinite choices, but the right explanation for YOU.
